name: Issue resolution desk
description: A config-driven multi-agent issue-resolution desk. GitHub issues (bound to tasks by the github sync) flow through a fixed process — a coordinator triages and assigns by role, an implementer resolves the issue in a sandbox, a deterministic step runs the repo's tests, a human signs off, and a pull request is opened. The whole app is data — a workflow + agents + views + a localized catalog — composed on the platform skeleton with no per-vertical system code.
